copayment_mechanisms.trigger: A reimbursement claim under Doctor Prescribed Investigations Cover - Pathology & Radiology is not pre-approved.
copayment_mechanisms.scope: Doctor Prescribed Investigations Cover - Pathology & Radiology reimbursement claims
copayment_mechanisms.exception_or_non_trigger: The clause does not establish this 20% copayment for pre-approved reimbursement claims or cashless investigation claims; any other independently applicable copayment remains a separate rule.
copayment_mechanisms.source_locator: Section C, III.A/B Doctor Prescribed Investigations Cover - Pathology & Radiology; note following reimbursement wording
copayment_mechanisms.reviewed_source_text: A Co-payment of 20% will be applicable on all reimbursement claims which are not pre-approved.

copayment_mechanisms.trigger: A claim is payable under the optional International Cover - Emergency Care only, subject to the cover-specific conditions.
copayment_mechanisms.exception_or_non_trigger: The rule is scoped to this optional international emergency cover and must not be generalized to domestic inpatient claims.
copayment_mechanisms.schedule_dependency_reason: The optional cover and applicable Sum Insured are specified through the Policy Schedule; claim-specific applicability cannot be inferred from generic wording alone.
copayment_mechanisms.source_locator: Optional Covers, International Cover - Emergency Care only, Specific Conditions item c
copayment_mechanisms.reviewed_source_text: A mandatory Co-payment of 10% is applicable which will be in addition to any other Co-payment/deductible if any applicable in the policy.

copayment_mechanisms.trigger: The Voluntary Co-payment option is selected and a claim is admitted under In-patient Hospitalization Treatment.
copayment_mechanisms.scope: Admitted In-patient Hospitalization Treatment claims where the voluntary copayment option applies
copayment_mechanisms.exception_or_non_trigger: No single copayment percentage can be asserted without the selected voluntary copayment option; the generic wording only establishes the permitted 5%, 10%, 15%, or 20% options and their relationship to the discount availed.
copayment_mechanisms.schedule_dependency_reason: The applicable percentage depends on the voluntary copayment option/discount selected for the policy instance.
copayment_mechanisms.source_locator: General Conditions / Discounts, item x Voluntary Co-payment Discount
copayment_mechanisms.reviewed_source_text: If a claim has been admitted under In-patient Hospitalization Treatment then, the Insured shall bear a 5% or 10% or 15% or 20% (proportion to extent to discount availed) of the eligible claim amount payable under this Policy.

governance_decision.reason: The current wording contains multiple copayment mechanisms with different triggers, scopes, rates, stacking behavior, and policy-instance dependencies.
governance_decision.next_gate: Bind each mechanism separately to deterministic evidence candidates from the registered v2 primary legal source before canonical projection or publication review.
